newsitem.title: INDIA: Four injured as blast rocks hotel in India.
newsitem.headline: Four injured as blast rocks hotel in India.

text.p: Four people were injured, three of them seriously, in a blast at a hotel in the southern Indian city of Madras, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Saturday.
The news agency did not say what caused the blast but added police suspected a religious fundamentalist group was to blame for the explosion that took place late on Friday.
Police were investigating the case, the PTI said.
